notes: The gloss «قال ابن المثنى حدثني عبد الأعلى» repeats the same man: one link (rule 7), occurrence 1 kept.
«وهو أبو همام» is an identity gloss: left out (rule 9).
Damad speaks inside Ibn Abbas's account, but the relayed saying is the Prophet's words: Damad stays out (rule 6); Ibn Abbas is the last link.
